sources.title: Getting started with Chinese 3: 3
reviewed_claims: A basic comparison with 比 uses the order A + 比 + B + adjective.
比 is placed between the two compared people or things, with the adjective after B.
The reviewed page illustrates the pattern with 王京比李月高。

sources.title: Getting started with Chinese 2: 7
reviewed_claims: For an action at a location, the location expression 在 + place comes before the action verb.
The reviewed page illustrates the pattern with 我在北京学中文。

sources.title: Getting started with Chinese 2: 3
reviewed_claims: 什么 replaces the unknown answer element and remains in the position where that answer would appear.
The reviewed page uses 他明天晚上做什么？ to show 什么 after 做 in the answer slot.

sources.title: Getting started with Chinese 2: Week 2: 4
reviewed_claims: When 都 means both/all in a basic statement, it is placed before the verb.
The reviewed page illustrates this placement with 老师们都是英国人吗？, where 都 precedes 是.

sources.title: Getting started with Chinese 2: 8
sources.reviewed_section_title: 8 Choice questions with háishi 还是
reviewed_claims: 还是 links the alternatives in a choice question.
A choice question with 还是 does not add 吗 at the end.
The reviewed page illustrates the pattern with 她是英国人还是美国人？
